                                 FROM THE PRINCIPAL’S DESK




Dear Learners,

Greetings!

As we gear up for another academic year filled with promise and potential, it gives me great pleasure to
extend a warm welcome to all prospective students to Behali Degree College, Borgang.

Behali Degree College stands out as one of the leading undergraduate institutions in Biswanath District,
affiliated to Madhabdev University, maintaining high academic standards and offering accessible,
quality education to empower students from all walks of life. Recently accredited with a B+ Grade from
NAAC, our college has been pivotal in providing higher education opportunities, nurturing talents,
instilling true human values, and fostering universal brotherhood particularly in rural and remote areas.
The increasing enrolment figures underscore the college’s significance and demand in the greater Behali
area.

The college has adopted a Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) in line with the National
Education Policy (NEP) 2020 since the academic year (2023-24). This policy promotes critical thinking,
problem-solving skills, and creativity through a flexible credit-based system. It encourages
interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary learning, allowing students to explore various fields of study and
customize their educational journey based on their interests and aspirations. Moreover, with study
centers from Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU) and Gauhati University Centre

                                 THE COLLEGE AT A GLANCE


Behali Degree College, affiliated to Gauhati University was established in 1989 by some enthusiastic
and active citizens of Behali. In a recent notification dated 10/02/2024, Govt. of Assam Higher
Education Department listed Behali Degree College to Madhabdev University. It now stands as a
premier institute in the Biswanath district. The college is proud of its alumni who have carved their
names in various educational and professional fields.
With the establishment of science stream in 2020, the college now has number of highly qualified
faculty members who are catering to over a thousand students. The college strongly believes the new
students will be highly benefitted by its teaching staff. An active mentor-mentee system in which the
students are attached to one faculty who acts as their mentor is used by the college for personal care of
the students. The college also has dedicated non-teaching staff to efficiently carry out their respective
works.
The college has a new building with well-furnished classrooms facilities. To enrich the students with
appropriate support, a new library building under the aegis of Mr. Ranjit Dutta, MLA, Behali has been
constructed. The college library provides facilities like textbooks, reference books, journals, and
periodicals etc. The college is a member of N-List Care, an initiative of MHRD, with access to millions
of e-resources that would provide conductive study materials in online mode. The college also provides
support to students interested to use SWAYAM, an E learning platform initiated by MHRD, Govt. of
India.
The NCC and NSS units of the college are highly active to facilitate interested students in engaging
activities throughout the year.
In addition, Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU) and Gauhati University Centre
for Distance and Online Education (GUCDOE) are also available.

NEP-2020 (FYUGP)
Under Graduate Course for the Session 2026-27

About NEP-2020 (FYUGP)
A Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) with multiple entries and exits. In this
programme, one has the choice to exit from the programme thrice – after one year, after two years and
after three years.

PROGRESSION

In FYUGP, students get a Bachelor Degree with Major after 3 years and a degree with Major & Honours
or a degree with Honours with Research after 4 years. If a student exits the FYUGP after 3 years, she/he
will need to take admission into the first year of a Master’s programme, which is a 2-year Master degree
programme. However, if a student fully completes an FYUGP, she/he needs to take admission into the
second year of a Master’s programme and needs to complete only one year to get a Master Degree. Once
a student takes admission into a Master’s programme either after 3 years of the Bachelor’s programme
or after FYUGP, one will be able to take admission into a Doctoral programme leading to the Degree of
PhD. However, if a student is exceptionally good, one can directly take admission into a Doctoral
programme right after the FYUGP, by passing the Master’s programme.

OUR COURSES

Basically, there are two parts of a course under the FYUGP – (a) Core Courses and (b) Common Courses.
As the name suggests, different students study different core courses and all students study the common
courses. The minimum credit allocation for a 3-year programme is 66 credits in Core Courses and 62
credits in Common Courses, which comes to a total of minimum 128 credits for a 3-year programme. With
the fourth year, the minimum credit requirement becomes 174.

CORE COURSES
The Core Courses determine the ultimate degree, diploma, or certificate a student will earn at the end of
third (or fourth) year, second year, or first year, respectively. The Core Courses have to be chosen among a
plethora of subjects offered for both the types of degrees, respectively. In case of a Bachelor’s Degree in a
Stream, the components of the Core Courses are Major and / or Minors. Usually, for majority of the
students, the Core Course will consist of one Major and one Minor.

COMMON COURSES
The common courses are to be studied by all students alike and all-together they carry total credits of 34
over a 3-year period. These courses are further divided into following sub-categories:

Multi-disciplinary Course (MDC): These are 3-credit courses spanning over different groups of subjects.

Ability Enhancement Course (AEC): An Ability Enhancement Course is aimed at providing the student
with skill and ability. The Ability Enhancement Courses must be opted by a student and the student can
choose papers from a pool of Skill Enhancement Courses. This is an 8-credit course in total covering
Language/ Alternative English and English Usage (Communication).

Skill Enhancement Course (SEC): These are various skill courses with total credit allocation of 10. All
students need to complete three skill courses during Semesters 1-3.

Value Added Course (VAC): The VAC courses will come from various sub groups comprises of
Introduction to Yoga, NSS & Youth development, Sports & Physical Education, Primary skills on Rover &
Ranger and Environmental Studies. All together they will have a credit allocation of 7. Each student will
have to take any three courses from any three groups during Semesters 1, 2, & 3.

Internship: All students are to carry out an internship with a credit allocation of 4. The internship is
expected to be carried out in Semester 4 & 5. The internships are meant to be done during semester breaks
they will not interfere with other classes.

Research Project: A student can opt (Subject to conditions) a dissertation or a project work of 2 credits in
the Sixth Semester.
